payload.title: R3: Live screening on Jev, S/F x 4 + S+8-shot on top 2 (~1,200 req, cap ~$1) -> STOP: owner picks
payload.description:
## Purpose

Live screening on Jev to apply pass rules (a) and (c), with F as an informative ceiling, then **STOP: owner picks the dataset**.

## Scope

- ~120 stratified items per candidate, drawn only from the pool split (fixed seed, ids recorded).
- 4 candidates x 2 conditions (S, F) = ~960 Jev requests (~$0.5 at ~$0.4-0.6 per 1,000).
- Then S + 8 fixed few-shot examples (from the pool, disjoint from the 120) on the top 2 candidates: ~240 requests (~$0.12).
- Macro-F1, accuracy, per-class recall, paired bootstrap CIs (S vs F, S vs S+8, Jev-S vs supervised baseline on the same items where possible).
- Fresh ledger; `--max-new-requests` = printed bound; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class.

## Definition of done

Screening table (license, guideline, human ceiling, supervised baseline, Jev-S, Jev-F, Jev-S+8) with pass/fail on (a)-(c) per candidate and a recommendation; text-free results committed; **STOP: owner picks the dataset** (or none). Record the decision on the "Owner decision" task.

## Cost

~1,200 Jev requests; **hard cap ~$1**.
